findings.evidence: The visual headline is a <div class="big">, so the page has no heading at all; the sweep reported '0 visible h1', and the judgment here is that the only candidate heading exists but is not marked up.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 2.4.6 Headings and Labels.

findings.evidence: dom-1440 meta is empty: there is no <meta name="viewport">. Real phones will lay the page out at about 980px and scale it down, making the 17px body text about 6px; the 375 capture shows the narrow layout only because the harness forced the width.
At 375px the fixed 2fr/1fr grid keeps the navy panel, which squeezes the claim to two characters per line (375-00.png: 四千 / 八百 / 张截 …), 20 lines for one sentence, and the page is 414px wide (sweep).
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 Reflow: content must read in one column without loss at 320 CSS px.
